production_reason: No deploy record was captured. The deploy workflow copies repository variables into the Worker when set, so wrangler.jsonc cannot show the served values.

sources.claim: The complete vars object of wrangler.jsonc names neither FLEET_ENABLED nor FLEET_MAP_ENABLED.
The workflow file is named Fleet AIS health.
It runs on a schedule and on manual dispatch.
Its check job runs only when the repository variable ENABLE_FLEET is the string true.
The config builder allowlists the fleet variables by name.
The deploy workflow passes the two fleet flags from repository variables.
The page defines LIVE, PREVIEW, DESIGNED and UNVERIFIED.
sources.excerpt:
| LIVE | A cited deploy record proves that the served site runs a head containing the feature. **No row on this page is LIVE.** A merge to `main` does not prove what is served. A green `deploy-cloudflare.yml` run does not prove it either, because the workflow can deploy an older eligible commit or deploy nothing and still report success. |
| PREVIEW | The code and documents are merged at the pinned commit, and a merge or commit record is cited. Whether captains can see the feature on the served site, and whether its data is current, is not proven here. |
| DESIGNED | Documents, code or a dated snapshot exist, but no receipt at the pinned commit shows a qualified, cited data product. |
| UNVERIFIED | The claim cannot be checked from the repository at the pinned commit. |

sources.claim: Qualified-data claims count as UNVERIFIED without a dated receipt.
sources.excerpt: A claim that a feature produced qualified, cited data counts as UNVERIFIED unless the row cites a dated receipt present at the pinned commit. Dates and run links quoted *inside* a feature document are that document's own claims. This page does not re-verify them.

limits: Repository-only observation. It does not show the served configuration or the production flag values.

The run is the latest one the query returned. Its head commit is independent of repository_commit, and a workflow conclusion does not show that the job ran, that AIS data is fresh or that the fleet is healthy.
No flag, workflow, fleet data or health endpoint was touched, and nothing here approves publication.
